CITY OF SAN MARINO

  CITY COUNCIL AGENDA

Steven W. Huang, DDS, Mayor  www.CityofSanMarino.org
Gretchen Shepherd Romey, Vice Mayor  (626) 300-0700 Phone

Tony Chou, Council Member  City Hall Council Chamber

Calvin Lo, Council Member  2200 Huntington Drive
Steve Talt, Council Member  San Marino, CA 91108

Philippe Eskandar, City Manager

  REGULAR MEETING OF THE
  SAN MARINO CITY COUNCIL
  WEDNESDAY, FEBRUARY 14, 2024 AT 6:00 PM
  CITY HALL COUNCIL CHAMBERS
  2200 HUNTINGTON DRIVE
  SAN MARINO, CA 91108
  AND
  NO. 56, PINGDING RD., UNIT 56-7, 11TH FLOOR
  TAMSUI DISTRICT, NEW TAIPEI CITY, TAIWAN 251

The City of San Marino appreciates your attendance. Citizens’ interest provides the Council
with valuable information regarding issues of the community.

Regular meetings are held on the 2nd Wednesday of every month at 6:00 p.m. Typically,
adjourned meetings are held on the last Friday of every month at 8:30 a.m.

In compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act, any person with a disability who
requires a reasonable modification or accommodation in order to participate in a meeting
should contact the City Clerk via email at CityClerk@CityofSanMarino.org or by phone at
(626) 300-0705 prior to the meeting for assistance.

The public is welcome to attend the meeting in person or remotely via Zoom, however, the
meeting will proceed as normal even if there are technical difficulties with Zoom. The City
will do it’s best to resolve any technical issues as quickly as possible.

How to view or listen to the meeting from home:
  Visit www.CityofSanMarino.org/Zoom

AGENDA – FEBRUARY 14, 2024  PAGE 1 of 5
 How to offer public comment from home:

  Public comment will be accepted by email to CityClerk@CityofSanMarino.org until
  3:00 p.m. the day before the meeting. Written public comment received by 3:00
  p.m. will be distributed to City Council during the meeting. Any comments received
  after 3:00 p.m. will be included in the public comment record but not provided to
  City Council at the meeting.
  Written public comment will be accepted electronically via the zoom.us
  teleconference module during the meeting. Written Zoom comments will be accepted
  after the in-person comments.

CALL TO ORDER

PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE

ROLL CALL

Council Member Chou, Council Member Lo, Council Member Talt, Vice Mayor Shepherd
Romey, and Mayor Huang

POSTING OF AGENDA

The agenda is posted 72 hours prior to each meeting at the following locations: City Hall,
2200 Huntington Drive, the Crowell Public Library, 1890 Huntington Drive, and the
Stoneman Building, 1560 Pasqualito Drive. The agenda is also posted on the City’s website:
http://www.cityofsanmarino.org.

PUBLIC COMMENTS

The City welcomes public input. Members of the public may address the City Council by
completing a public comment card and giving it to the City Clerk prior to the meeting. At
this time, the public may address the City Council on items that are not on the agenda.
Pursuant to state law, the City Council may not discuss or take action on issues not on the
meeting agenda (Government Code Section 54954.2). The Mayor reserves the right to
place limits on duration of comments. Staff may be asked to follow up on such items.

CITY MANAGER'S REPORT

This is an opportunity for the City Manager to inform the City Council and the public of any
upcoming events or matters of interest to the community.

  PRESENTATION

 PRESENTATION OF CERTIFICATES TO SAN MARINO PUBLIC LIBRARY FOUNDATION
 BOOKMARK CONTEST WINNERS

AGENDA – FEBRUARY 14, 2024  PAGE 2 of 5
   PUBLIC HEARINGS

 1.  CONSIDERATION OF AN APPEAL OF THE PLANNING COMMISSION’S
  DECISION TO APROVE DESIGN REVIEW CASE NOS. 21-25 & 21-73 AT
  1408 WILSON AVENUE FOR A FIRST AND SECOND STORY 418
  SQUARE-FOOT ADDITION (SIGO GROUP MANAGEMENT, LLC)

  Recommendation: Staff recommends the Council affirm the adoption of Planning
  Commission Resolution No. PCR 23-19. If the City Council concurs with staff’s
  recommendation, an appropriate motion would be:

  “I move to adopt City Council Resolution No. R-24-01 affirming the adoption of
  Planning Commission Resolution No. PCR 23-19 approving Design Review Permit
  Numbers DRC 21-25 and DR 21-73 at 1408 Wilson Avenue to allow a 287 sq ft one-
  story addition and a 131 sq ft second-story addition.”

  NEW BUSINESS

 2.  RECEIVE AND FILE THE REVISED CITYWIDE TRAFFIC CIRCULATION
  STUDY PREPARED BY ITERIS AND THE TRAFFIC TASK FORCE REPORT,
  AND AUTHORIZE STAFF TO BEGIN FURTHER REVIEW AND ANALYSIS
  OF POTENTIAL INTERSECTION IMPROVEMENTS AT SAN MARINO
  AVENUE/HUNTINGTON DRIVE, LOS ROBLES AVENUE/MISSION
  STREET AND SIERRA MADRE BOULEVARD/ROBLES AVENUE AND
  BEGIN IMPLEMENTATION OF THE “QUICK FIX” CONSIDERATIONS
  FOR TRAFFIC SAFETY IMPROVEMENT CITYWIDE.

  Recommendation: Staff recommends 1) the City Council receive and file the revised
  draft Citywide Traffic Circulation Study, dated April 25 2023, prepared by Iteris, and
  the Traffic Task Force report, and 2) authorize staff to begin further review and
  analysis of potential intersection improvements at San Marino Avenue/Huntington
  Drive, Los Robles Avenue/Mission Street, and Sierra Madre Boulevard/Robles Avenue,
  and begin implementation of the “quick fix” considerations for the improvement of
  traffic safety citywide. If the Council concurs with staff’s recommendation, an
  appropriate motion would be:

  “I move to 1) Receive and file the Revised Citywide Traffic Circulation Study, dated
  April 25, 2023, prepared by Iteris, and the Traffic Task Force report, and 2) authorize
  staff to begin further review and analysis of potential intersection improvements at
  San Marino Avenue/Huntington Drive, Los Robles Avenue/Mission Street, and Sierra
  Madre Boulevard/Robles Avenue, and begin implementation of the “quick fix”
  considerations for the improvement of traffic safety citywide.”

AGENDA – FEBRUARY 14, 2024  PAGE 3 of 5
   CONSENT CALENDAR

 3.  REJECTION OF ALL BIDS FOR THE STREETLIGHT REPLACEMENT
  PROGRAM PROJECT NO. 23-9274

  Recommendation: Staff recommends that the City Council reject all bids for the
  Streetlight Replacement Program Project No. 23-9274 and authorize staff to consider
  revising the scope of the project and/or consider other alternatives to complete the
  project. If the Council concurs with staff’s recommendation, an appropriate motion
  would be:

  “I move to reject all bids for the Streetlight Replacement Program Project No. 23-
  9274.”

 4.  RECEIVE AND  FILE  MONTHLY  DISBURSEMENTS  REPORT  FOR
  JANUARY 2024

  Recommendation: Staff recommends the Council receive and file the Monthly
  Disbursements Report for the month of January 2024. If the City Council concurs
  with staff’s recommendation, an appropriate motion would be:

  “I move to receive and file the Monthly Disbursements Report for the month of
  January 2024.”

 5.  CASH AND INVESTMENT REPORT FOR THE MONTH OF DECEMBER
  2023

  Recommendation: Staff recommends the Council receive and file this report. If the
  City Council concurs with staff’s recommendation, an appropriate motion would be:

  “I move to receive and file the Cash and Investment Report for the Month of
  December 2023.”

 6.  APPROVAL OF MINUTES

  Recommendation: Staff recommends the Council approve the January 2024 minutes.
  If the City Council concurs with staff’s recommendation, an appropriate motion would
  be:

  “I move to approve the minutes of the regular meeting of January 10, 2024, the
  adjourned regular meeting of January 26, 2024, and the special meeting of January
  26, 2024.”

AGENDA – FEBRUARY 14, 2024  PAGE 4 of 5
 WRITTEN COMMUNICATIONS OR PUBLIC WRITINGS DISTRIBUTION

This is an opportunity to announce any written communications pertaining to the City
received by members of the City Council. All public writings distributed by the City of San
Marino to at least a majority of the City Council regarding any item on this agenda will be
made available at the Public Counter at City Hall located at 2200 Huntington Drive, San
Marino, California 91108, and will also be included in the public agenda packet that will
available for review at the City Council meeting.
